The '''K-9 series hunting-and-tracking droid''' were [[Big game hunter/Legends|hunting]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. They were the size of a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] baby and looked like a [[Dog/Legends|dog]].<ref name="Enter the Unknown" />

A K-9 was about forty [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long, and although it was intended to imitate a dog in both appearance and behavior, it had a box-like shape. Although images of the K-9 show the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had four legs, it appears they moved via a small bank of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] coils located on the underside.<ref name="Jedi Dawn">''[[Jedi Dawn]]''</ref>

K-9's were voice controlled and could be programmed to respond only to specific individuals, such as their owner's. The model was equipped with standard, basic recording capabilities including audio and flatscreen video recording, which could be replayed by projecting the image from the optical sensors onto a flat surface, such as a wall. However, the series was not equipped with [[Hologram/Legends|holorecording]] or playback capabilities.<ref name="Jedi Dawn" />

A small panel on the back of a K-9 held a DNA-sample reader, which if pressed by someone with the correct clearance would open a secret panel hidden on the droid's body. The hatch could not be easily identified and could not be penetrated by most [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans. This made the droids useful for keeping safe items that the owner wanted to remain hidden&mdash;such as a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for example.<ref name="Jedi Dawn" />
